target: forge.sh kind — a declared value outside github|gitlab|none exits non-zero, names it on stderr, prints nothing on stdout, never falls back
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://github.com/o/r.git
export FORGE=bogusforge; fx_run kind; fx_show env; unset FORGE
printf 'FORGE=weirdenv\n' > .env; fx_run kind; fx_show dotenv; rm .env
fx_config '{"forge":{"kind":"cfgweird"}}'; fx_run kind; fx_show cfg; rm -rf .agentic
fx_done
